column1: # Savers: the one source for the firmware defines (scripts/gen_awto_savers.py -> fw/test/saver.c) and the host names (scripts/saver_names.py, ./dev.py saver).
# name = host name; macro = C suffix (AWTO_SAVER_<macro> = run id, AWTO_SAVER_NOW_<macro> = DDC/CI VCP 0xEB value); run / vcp "-" = none.
# VCP 0xEB: 0 stop, 5 flash, 6 alert tone, 7 splash; other values are ignored (1..4, 8 were the games, see docs/games.md).
# Run ids 1..4 and 7 and VCP values 1..4 and 8 were Pac-Man / Scope 1 / Scope 2 / Alternate / Asteroids: removed 2026-11-25, not reused.
